basic_details.job_title: District Panchayat Dhamtari Accountant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Panchayat Dhamtari has notified 4 vacancies for the post of Accountant on a contract basis. Candidates can apply offline by sending the application in the prescribed format in a closed envelope by registered post or speed post to the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Dhamtari, ensuring it reaches by 22 October 2026 till 5:30 PM. The qualification requirement for the Accountant post is with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST), and the pay is Rs. 23,350 consolidated. content_sections.heading: District Panchayat Dhamtari Accountant at a Glance

rows.details: District Panchayat Dhamtari (Viksit Bharat - GRAM G)
Degree in B.Com. with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent in a closed envelope to the following postal address by registered post or speed post: Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Dhamtari (Chhattisgarh) Envelope Marking: The envelope must clearly state the name of the post being applied for ("आवंटित पद का नाम वर्ग").

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Degree in B.Com. with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST candidates). Age Limit: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years as on 01.01.2026. Age relaxations apply as per Chhattisgarh government rules (including up to 5 years relaxation for local resident unemployed youth of Chhattisgarh, subject to a maximum age limit of 45 years after all relaxations). Other Conditions: Candidates must be local residents of Chhattisgarh with a valid domicile certificate issued by a competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of required educational certificates and marksheets Domicile certificate issued by a competent authority Permanent caste certificate Experience certificates (if claiming experience) Recent passport-size photograph pasted on the application form

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on merit calculated through weightage across multiple criteria: Higher Secondary marks (up to 20 marks), essential educational qualification percentage (up to 50 marks), computer practical test (15 marks), and experience in government rural development schemes (up to 15 marks based on duration). Candidates will be called for the computer practical test in a 1:10 ratio.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Accountant post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary and on a contract basis with an initial term up to 28 February 2027, extendable based on performance and capability.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation or marks relaxation?
faq.answer: Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates receive a relaxation in qualification marks, requiring 50% in B.Com. instead of 55%. Age relaxations are provided as per Chhattisgarh government norms, including a 5-year relaxation for local resident unemployed youth of the state.

faq.question: Q3. Are candidates from other states eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates must be local residents of the state of Chhattisgarh and provide a valid domicile certificate.

faq.question: Q4. What documents need to be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested photocopies of their marksheets, educational certificates, domicile certificate, caste certificate, experience certificates, and paste a recent passport-size photograph on the application form.
